grammar.title: Working something out with 找出
grammar.explanation: 找出 (zhǎochū) means "to find, to identify, to figure out" a result complement showing that searching led to success.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎochū le wèntí de yuányīn.
sentences.en: He found the reason for the problem.
We need to find a solution.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎochū le nà běn shū.

sentences.zh: 你能找出这个问题的办法吗？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng zhǎochū zhège wèntí de bànfǎ ma?
sentences.en: Can you find a solution to this problem?

sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎochū le wèntí de yuányīn.
sentences.en: He found out the reason for the problem.
